title: Evaluating the effectiveness of Stochastic CTMC and deterministic models in correlating rabies persistence in human and dog populations
summary: Rabies continues to pose a significant zoonotic threat particularly in areas with high populations of domestic dogs that serve as viral reservoirs. This study conducts a comparative analysis of Stochastic Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) and deterministic models to gain insights into rabies persistence within human and canine populations.
